name: Wadini Junk Wizard (CR 1/2)
body:
WADINI JUNK WIZARD
CR 1/2

This small humanoid wears a flat black face mask and goggles that obscures their face. The rest of their body is likewise carefully covered by gear, including a brown hooded robe laid overtop of everything. Bits of wire and tools hang from a belt at their waist, and a sleek crossbow rests in their hand.

XP 200
Wadini technomancer 1
N Small humanoid (wadini)
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +4

DEFENSE

AC 16, touch 14, flat-footed 13 (+1 size, +3 Dex, +2 armor)
hp 10 (1d8+1+1)
Fort +1, Ref +3, Will +2; +2 vs. disease, poison, mind-affecting effects, and the nauseated or sickened condition

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft.
Melee synthetic light mace +1 (1d4-1 B)
Ranged synthetic light crossbow +5 (1d6 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 80 ft.; AP 1)
Special Attacks empower weapon (+1/+1d6)

Spells Prepared (CL 1st; concentration +4)

0-level (at will)—daze (DC 13), fabricate scrap, mending, transfer charge
1st-level (2/day)—break (DC 14), junk grenade I (DC 14)

STATISTICS

Str 9, Dex 16, Con 12, Int 17, Wis 10, Cha 6
Base Atk +0; CMB -2; CMD 11
Feats Rapid Reload (light crossbow), Technologist
Skills Disable Device +9, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (engineering) +7, Perception +4, Spellcraft +7, Stealth +8, Survival +3; Racial Modifiers +2 Disable Device, +2 Survival
Languages Common, Wadini
SQ arcane pool (4 points), spell cache, technomantic talents (transmutation)
Gear NPC gear (Small carbonfiber armor, Small synthetic light crossbow with 10 bolts, Small synthetic light mace, masterwork thieves’ tools, other gear)

ABOUT

Scavengers, thieves, and second-hand merchants, wadini are found in many of the Galaxy’s major space ports. While most people consider them a nuisance, it is not wise to double-cross them. Led by a wadini junk wizard, a crew of wadini are quick to exact revenge by stripping their enemy’s speeder or booby-trapping their starship.

Galactic Legions, Vol. 2: In the Shadow of the Empire. 2026, Far Distant Future Publishing; Author. Bryan Mangum.
